text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, your cup is empty.
Allow me to get you a fresh one—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...There is no problem.
I just had a slight headache, that is all.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
choice_data_list: I can pour it myself, so don't push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!
I am deeply sorry, Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: To think I've caused my master to worry... I will have this pain healed right away, so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal suffered from
a headache for a while..."
